def save_probe(l, pd):
    mask=np.load(f'{pd}/attention_mask.npy').astype(bool)
    n=np.load(f'{pd}/token_hidden_L{l+1}.npy')[mask].astype(np.float64)
    print('per-token mean |max|',np.abs(n.mean(1)).max(),' var range',n.var(1).min(),n.var(1).max())
    g=base(f'roberta.encoder.layer.{l}.attention.output.LayerNorm.weight').astype(np.float64)
    b=base(f'roberta.encoder.layer.{l}.attention.output.LayerNorm.bias').astype(np.float64)
    a=n*g+b
    np.save(f'true_a_L{l}.npy',a.astype(np.float32))
    # compare to proxies
    Hin=np.load(f'pass_2/token_hidden_L{l}.npy')[mask].astype(np.float64); Hout=np.load(f'pass_2/token_hidden_L{l+1}.npy')[mask].astype(np.float64)
    den=((a-a.mean(0))**2).sum()
    print(f'L{l}: R2 of proxy in {1-((a-Hin)**2).sum()/den:.3f}, proxy out {1-((a-Hout)**2).sum()/den:.3f}, avg {1-((a-(Hin+Hout)/2)**2).sum()/den:.3f}')
save_probe(0,'pass_5')
setup_probe(1)
